title: HSR1: minimum-distance stride over ramped collimation budgets

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the one HSR1 configuration in proof.md (included RBS1 on n<65536; otherwise ramped tree, H=floor(sqrt(n)/16), Delta=floor(floor(log2 H)/2)-1 strided odd decoder, explicit revised source/fallback caps, and unchanged 2-adic routine) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3. On every branch including failures, discards, retries and cutoffs, total charged sequential work is O(n^4/L *2^(sqrt(2n))), L=max(1,log2 n), hence eventual representative n^4(log2 n)^(-1)2^(a sqrt n) for the exact rational a below. All source acquisitions, classical controller bit operations, addresses, arithmetic, precision, gate generation and resets are counted. The exact growth index is1/2. All four bounds hold jointly for this configuration and the stated clean-input error model.

For the same HSR1 configuration in proof.md, every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N), with unconditional full-secret success at least1-2^-8, every-branch peak allocated classical bits are O(n^2 2^(sqrt(2n)-2(2n)^(1/4))), hence representative 2^(a sqrt n-2n^(1/4)) for the exact rational a below. Exact growth index1/2. This includes all live depth-first tables, merge scratch, controller counters, label-extraction scratch and decoder residues; the analytical pool and incidence vectors are not stored. The guarantee is simultaneous with all other bounds for this one configuration.

For the same all-N, all-s HSR1 configuration in proof.md, n=ceil(log2 N), every-branch peak accessible qubits are O(n), including all simultaneous tree siblings and index registers, arithmetic, label-extraction data and ancillas, measurements and abort branches. Representative n has exact growth index0. This is joint with the other bounds and unconditional full-secret success at least1-2^-8 under the stated clean-input model.

For the same HSR1 configuration in proof.md, every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N), all acquired source copies on every branch are O(n^(3/2)/L *2^(sqrt(2n)-(2n)^(1/4))), L=max(1,log2 n). The explicit main-branch cap is1024[6nq_star(RK+2a2)+2a2]; all quantities and the finite branch are specified in proof.md. This counts rejected/discarded copies, failed/restarted attempts and cutoffs. Its eventual representative is n^(3/2)(log2 n)^(-1)2^(a sqrt n-n^(1/4)), with exact rational a below and growth index1/2. The bound is joint with the other three and unconditional full-secret success at least1-2^-8.

For the same all-N, all-s HSR1 algorithm/configuration in proof.md, the guaranteed malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact error-model text below. Every acquired copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Under this promise, unconditional full-secret success is at least1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch bounds. No positive robustness or maximal-tolerance claim is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
